name: Solstice
source:
A city in the middle of an icy desert, cut off from the world by raging blizzards. Inhabited only by a small group of misfits who either can’t or don’t want to leave for the winter. When the local archaeologist goes missing, a bored doctor on a contract and a young woman who arrived with the last dog sled caravan pick on the trail.

What starts as an innocent investigation to pass the time, may result in the cold wasteland finally claiming the once proud city.
translation:
一座坐落在冰冷沙漠中央、被肆虐暴风雪与世隔绝的城市。城中只住着一小群不合群的人，他们要么无法离开，要么不愿在冬天离开。当当地的考古学家失踪后，一名无聊的合约医生和一位随最后一支狗拉雪橇商队抵达的年轻女子踏上了追查线索的旅程。

一场原本只是为了消磨时间的无害调查，最终可能让冰冷的荒原吞噬这座曾经骄傲的城市。
